# Daily AI Briefing — February 27, 2026

> **Headline:** Major advances in reasoning and open-source models dominate the week.

## AI Research

### 1. Chain-of-Thought Reasoning at Scale

**Source:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.12345

**TL;DR:** New paper demonstrates that chain-of-thought reasoning can be improved by 30% through a novel training technique.

The paper introduces a method for improving reasoning in large language models by using a combination of reinforcement learning and synthetic data generation.

### 2. Efficient Fine-Tuning with LoRA++

**Source:** https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.54321

**TL;DR:** LoRA++ achieves 95% of full fine-tuning performance at 10x lower cost.

The authors extend the LoRA framework with adaptive rank selection and gradient accumulation strategies.

## Tech Industry

### Anthropic Raises $5B Series D

**Source:** https://techcrunch.com/2026/02/27/anthropic-funding

**TL;DR:** Anthropic closes largest AI funding round, valued at $60B.

The funding will be used to scale compute infrastructure and expand the Claude model family.

## Development

### Open Source Transformer Library v5.0

**Source:** https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/releases/tag/v5.0.0

**TL;DR:** Major release includes native support for mixture-of-experts and speculative decoding.

Breaking changes include a new tokenizer API and deprecated legacy model classes.

## News

### EU AI Act Implementation Begins

**Source:** https://reuters.com/technology/eu-ai-act-2026

**TL;DR:** First enforcement actions expected by Q3 2026 as companies rush to comply.

The regulation categorizes AI systems into risk tiers, with high-risk systems requiring conformity assessments.

## Key Takeaways

1. Reasoning capabilities continue to advance rapidly, with new training techniques closing the gap between chain-of-thought and human-level performance.
2. Open-source ecosystem keeps pace with proprietary models through efficient fine-tuning methods.
3. Regulatory landscape is solidifying, with concrete enforcement timelines emerging in the EU.
